units.source_text: 那姑娘上身穿藏青地碎白花纹的窄袖和服，双肩上斜系着揽袖带 [4] ；

en.t: The girl wore a narrow-sleeved kimono on her upper body, dark blue with a pattern of tiny white flowers, and a sleeve cord was tied diagonally across both shoulders [4];

units.source_text: 下身穿裙裤，系着围裙；手戴手背套，头上还扎了头巾。

en.t: On her lower body she wore divided skirt-trousers and an apron; she had hand covers on her hands and a kerchief tied around her head.

units.source_text: 围裙一直绕到背后，两旁开衩。

en.t: The apron wrapped all the way around to her back and was slit open at both sides.

units.source_text: 她身上只有揽袖带和从裙裤露出来的细腰带是带红色的。

en.t: The only red touches on her were the sleeve cord and the narrow sash showing from under the skirt-trousers.

units.source_text: 其他姑娘也是同样的装扮。

en.t: The other girls were dressed the same way.
